27:       thrustOsc = null;

32:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
33:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
34:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
35:     osc.type = type;
36:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
37:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);

53:   let score = 0;

68:   // Input

72: 
73:   function update(dt) {
74:     // Update stars background
75:     stars.forEach(s => {
76:       s.y += ship.speed * dt * 0.3;
77:     });

79:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
80:       if (stars[i].y - stars[i].r > height) {
81:         stars[i].x = Math.random() * width;
82:         stars[i].y = -stars[i].r;

143:       if (rectCollide(ship, debris[i])) {
144:         // Play crash sound

148:         // Game over – stop animation

157:         packets.splice(i, 1);

159:     }
160:     return true;
